title: Marryandbride bestseller row
description: A shop row on white: a serif heading at the left and a small uppercase 'view all' link at the right, then product tiles (2:3 photos, tracked uppercase names, grey prices). Four across with 9px gaps from 1024px; on phones a swipeable row of tiles a bit over half the screen wide. Hovering a tile fades in its second photo.
notes: best with four products (the desktop grid is four columns); more scroll sideways on phones only
product photos are slots; empty ones show bg-muted placeholders
